test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, ‘ROAD’ is written as ‘QKZZ’, and ‘BAND’ is written as ‘AWMZ’. How will ‘TASK’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**‘ROAD’ is written as ‘QKZZ’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0403546f3c47024d34d0eee7cc7a6471e2aad1083f2493167314b61b9553cfe2.png] 

**‘BAND’ is written as ‘AWMZ’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d3a2c4d7e4b0d9a3cd8c7fedd58cd234868290d1fc7f0290968e00f18b5b19.png] 

Similarly, 

**'TASK' can be written as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1eca38a73dbba54477b2b5d75ce77a08902cd1003ca956be2f590574e9fc5468.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SWRG"**.
